name: brain
description: Ships the init and grill-me skills and the format specs. The brain/ folder lives at the repo root, so any agent that greps the repo finds it; the hooks that enforce read-first and update-on-resolve are Claude Code only.

interface.shortDescription: A brain/ folder, read first and kept current.
interface.longDescription: Keeps a project's durable context in a brain/ folder at the repo root: context.md for what things are, decisions/ for why the hard-to-reverse calls were made. Plain markdown that rides your normal pull request. No server, no account, no network.
defaultPrompt: Grill me on this plan, then record what lands.
